#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
src,out=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3])
bad=sorted(line.split('\t')[0] for line in src.read_text().splitlines()[1:] if line.split('\t')[1]=='down')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_text(''.join(x+'\n' for x in bad))
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
